connector.name: Git by Abhishekkumar2021
connector.registryDescription: Local Git via MCP: status, log, diff, file history, branches, and gated stage/commit. Pure-JS.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package git. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the abhishekkumar2021 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: GIT_ROOTS
env.description: Allowed repo root directories (comma-separated). Required — the server refuses to start without it.

env.name: GIT_WRITABLE
env.description: Set to 1 or true to enable local write tools (stage/commit/branch/checkout).
